verdict.rationale: Consensus's own machine-readable docs describe an official MCP server at mcp.consensus.app/mcp. It exposes search, paper detail, synthesis and the Consensus Meter, offers an anonymous trial tier, and documents an MCP parameter, `exclude_preprints=true`. The full developer docs at docs.consensus.app are walled, so connection setup, auth flow and the complete tool list are only summarized, and nothing hands-on shows an agent actually connecting. missing for 10: accessible in-depth MCP setup/connection docs, a complete documented tool list and auth flow for MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of a working agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: API and agent ready: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app
Power agent workflows that need citable scientific sources via the REST API or MCP server
pass `exclude_preprints=true` (MCP) or `excludePreprints=true` (REST API) to filter to peer-reviewed papers only.
Intended for trying the MCP server before signing up, not for production traffic
